resources.string: Choose how HyperKit works on your phone. You can change this any time from the main screen.
No root. Works on every HyperOS phone.

• Lock screen, ClockFace, Edge lighting, Wonderland wallpaper
• Edge gestures, Sound assistant, Quick tiles
• Notification history, App profiles, Hidden settings
• System tuner (with a one-time ADB command)
Needs Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. Everything in Standard, plus more.

• All permissions granted automatically – no ADB, service kept on
• Refresh rate lock and display density
• Charge limit (Battery Guardian)
• Freeze apps, force stop, open any app in a floating window
• Remove the gesture line / keyboard gap
• “Kill app” edge gesture, reboot to recovery / bootloader, restart System UI
Root access not granted. Allow HyperKit in your root manager or use Standard mode.
Root mode on, but some permissions could not be granted
Root mode never changes the system on its own: every root action runs only when you tap it.
Needed for lock screen notifications & music, edge lighting and notification history.
Your own lock screen: clock styles, wallpaper, notifications, music and shortcuts.
A dim, burn-in safe clock shown while charging or docked (screen saver). Pick it in Settings → Display → Screen saver.
The screen edges glow when a notification arrives.
Live wallpaper from your own photo that moves with the phone.
Choose a photo; it shifts with the tilt of your phone for a 3D depth effect. Uses the motion sensor only while the wallpaper is visible.
Every notification saved on the device – searchable, even deleted ones.
Per-app rotation, brightness, media volume and keep screen on.
Refresh rate, density, charge limit, gesture line, reboot menu.
Freeze apps, force stop, floating windows.
Shown over the system lock screen. Swipe up to unlock with your PIN, fingerprint or face as usual.

Your security is unchanged: after the swipe, HyperOS asks for your PIN / fingerprint. The under-display fingerprint icon becomes visible after the swipe. Incoming calls and alarms close this screen automatically.
Off: only the app name is shown while locked.
Double tap to turn off screen
When the screen is on and the notification is from another app.
Android does not let apps light up a turned-off screen, so lighting appears only while the screen is on (also over HyperKit\'s lock screen).
Stored only on this phone, up to the last 3000.
When the app opens these settings are applied, and restored when you leave it.
Re-enables HyperKit\'s accessibility and notification access if HyperOS turns them off (on boot and when you open the app).
Experimental – legacy MIUI key, some HyperOS builds ignore it. HyperOS also has this under Settings → Full screen.
Experimental – sets the Material You seed colour. Used by Google and many third-party apps; HyperOS\'s own apps may keep their colours.
Secure settings, modify settings, overlay, notification access, accessibility and no battery restrictions.
Locks the screen to one refresh rate.
Keep this display size? It will be reverted in 15 seconds.
Removes the HyperOS gesture-line overlay, which also removes the empty gap under keyboards. Can be restored at any time. Takes effect after a reboot.
Stops charging at the chosen level and resumes 5% below it, to reduce battery wear. Works on kernels that expose a charging switch.
No supported charging switch found on this phone. Use HyperOS\'s own Battery protection instead.
Frozen apps (❄) stay installed but cannot run or show notifications until you unfreeze them.
Careful: freezing the wrong system app can break your phone.
